data.long_meaning: Valerie's name comes from the Roman name Valerius, meaning 'strength' or 'ruler'. The name Valerie carries the meaning “Strength, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Valerie usually hope their child will grow to embody strength, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
